item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Control plane metrics collection for AKS with Managed Prometheus
item.description:
Control plane metrics collection for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with Azure Monitor Managed Service for Prometheus is now generally available. It provides native observability into key managed control plane components.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced platform metrics in Azure Monitor
item.description:
Azure Monitor now has advanced platform metrics in Public Preview starting July 15, 2026. The preview adds improved visibility into platform performance, resource health, and operational trends for supported Azure services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Add review cycles and time to adoption phases in the usage API
item.description:
The Copilot usage metrics API adds two review-velocity fields for each AI adoption phase in enterprise and organization reports. The new data extends the adoption phase cohort fields with review cycles and time in phase.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: OpenTelemetry Metrics, Visualizations, and Enhanced Monitoring in Azure Monitor for Azure VMs and Arc Servers
item.description:
Azure Monitor for Azure VMs and Arc Servers now generally available with OpenTelemetry metrics and visualizations, providing a unified monitoring experience. The release consolidates key monitoring capabilities into a single experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates
